how: The suggestions record, written by tools/suggest_ledger.js in the job and held by tools/suggest_check.js. featured: each game on national TV's four parlays on the Suggested Parlays tab (Safe, Medium, Aggressive, Extreme, 2 to 5 legs from that game alone, every bet type; a player's chance is the props model's, on trial), taken from the published page on the state just published and DraftKings' lines in lines.json, keyed season|date|tip|game, rewritten while the set's lock (2 hours before tip-off) is to come and locked from it, so each entry is the set as the job last published it before the lock; from the lock to tip-off a level holding a player the injury report has since listed is built again, that level alone, and recorded in updates. From tip-off it is graded as a book settles it, by the page's own settlement (the scores, and each player's box line: a player with none did not play, void): a leg lost loses; a push or void leg drops out and the rest are paid at the builder's price on the legs left; every leg a push or void is a push, the stake back; the payout on a $1 stake. featured_summary: per level, the parlays graded won or lost (each season's game and level once), won, the wins expected by DraftKings' fair chance and by the model's, and units on $1. Never edited by hand: the check refuses a ledger whose locked entries moved.
